Created: 2026-07-31 · Started: 2026-07-31 · Updated: 2026-07-31
Close reason: Implemented: removed --refresh-agencies from daily workflow, documented in AGENTS.md

DESCRIPTION

  slugs, discarding any slugs added by cross-agency spidering. Those          
  discovered slugs have real scraped data but fall out of batch rotation on   
  the next run.

  • Keep eyesonflock API data download (for name-to-slug map)                 
  • Skip the wa-agencies.json overwrite in refresh_agencies() when called from
  daily scrape                                                                
  • Agency list grows organically through sharing-network spidering

✓ scrape-flock-safety-subscriber-portals-edf · feat: track blocked state with retry backoff for consistently denied slugs   [● P2 · CLOSED]
Owner: Phil Mocek · Type: feature
Created: 2026-07-31 · Updated: 2026-08-01
Close reason: Deferred — directional sharing data captured, backfill complete. Backoff logic for heuristic-slug retries can be revisited when batch runs confirm which non-WA slugs are real.

DESCRIPTION

  The blocked.jsonl format currently stores {ts, error} without retry         
  metadata. Add a retry counter and backoff window so that:\n\n- Slugs blocked
  N consecutive times within a window are skipped on subsequent runs\n- Slugs 
  with no page.txt (never succeeded) but N blocks get a backoff: skip for 2^N 
  hours\n- Slugs with historical data (has page.txt) but recent blocks get a  
  shorter backoff: skip for 1 hour\n- Reset the counter on a successful       
  scrape\n- Never permanently drop a slug — we care about agencies that once  
  used Flock even if they stop.\n\nImplementation: update blocked.jsonl to    
  include {ts, error, retry_count}. Add a helper function to evaluate whether 
  a slug should be attempted based on its block history. The daily scrape     
  workflow should filter out backoff slugs before batching.

✓ scrape-flock-safety-subscriber-portals-phb · doc: deprecate eyesonflock.com as authoritative agency source   [● P2 · CLOSED]
Owner: Phil Mocek · Assignee: Phil Mocek · Type: task
Created: 2026-07-31 · Started: 2026-07-31 · Updated: 2026-07-31
Close reason: Implemented: removed --refresh-agencies from daily workflow, documented in AGENTS.md

DESCRIPTION

  eyesonflock.com lists only 41 WA Flock transparency portals, but cross-     
  agency spidering has discovered at least 8 more real portals not indexed    
  there. It is a third-party aggregator that lags behind actual Flock         
  deployment.                                                                 
                                                                              
  Decisions:                                                                  
                                                                              
  • stop calling refresh_agencies() in the daily scrape workflow              
  • eyesonflock API data download still useful for name-to-slug mapping (used 
  by NCIC contradiction detection)                                            
  • keep eyesonflock import at initial setup only — document this             
  • agency list grows organically through sharing-network spidering           
  • optionally run eyesonflock comparison as a periodic (weekly/monthly) check
  for brand-new agencies

○ scrape-flock-safety-subscriber-portals-s6m · Automate NCIC contradiction detection   [● P2 · OPEN]
Owner: Phil Mocek · Type: feature
Created: 2026-06-28 · Updated: 2026-06-28

DESCRIPTION

  Script that flags agencies in the scraper output exhibiting the Maass       
  contradiction: those that both prohibit immigration enforcement in their    
  policy AND subscribe to National and statewide hotlist sources (which       
  include the NCIC Immigration Violator File). Also detect data-sharing chains
  to agencies like Everett/Lynnwood that don't prohibit immigration           
  enforcement at all, since sharing data with them creates a backdoor for     
  immigration enforcement.                                                    



NOTES

  Acceptance Criteria:\n- Script runs against latest stats.jsonl and page.txt 
  across all WA agencies\n- Outputs report of agencies with the contradiction:
  prohibits immigration AND uses National/statewide hotlist sources\n- Detects
  agencies sharing data with Everett/Lynnwood\n- Results integrable into      
  GitHub Pages or CI
